summary: CD 2016-CD1 Mortgage Trust filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that, effective October 14, 2026, Torchlight Loan Services, LLC replaced CWCapital Asset Management LLC as special servicer for the Prudential Plaza mortgage loan and related pari passu and subordinate notes, a non-serviced loan combination governed by the COMM 2015-CCRE26 pooling and servicing agreement. Torchlight was appointed at the direction of CMBS CCR, LLC, the directing holder. Servicing remains governed by the existing PSA. No pricing, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or closing condition applies; this is an ordinary servicing-transfer notice, not a special situation.
